full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph catches an indistinct gathering along the edge of a broad bright body of water. In the central foreground, a woman in a dark calf-length dress passes from left to right in profile. Her head and shoulders have a soft blurred outline, and one forearm is held slightly forward. The movement makes her silhouette more immediate than the stiller people behind her. A low dark strip of grass or earth fills the lower third of the frame. Along its far edge, several small figures sit in scattered groups facing the water, while a few pale standing figures are softened almost into ghosts by motion or exposure. The precise actions of the background people are difficult to read. The water occupies a wide luminous middle band, nearly white where it reflects the sky. Beyond it, a darker opposite bank and horizontal bands of light and shade stretch across the upper edge. The horizon is high and indistinct. The viewpoint appears approximately level with the standing figures, making the central passerby tall within the frame. Strong backlighting reduces many people to simple silhouettes and lets the water become the dominant source of brightness. Film grain, soft focus, and irregular movement blur are visible across the scene, especially in the pale figure on the left and the dark shape on the right. The image keeps deep blacks in the foreground, broad silvery whites in the water, and relatively few middle tones. No legible signs or words appear. Rather than describing a specific event, the picture conveys a brief, almost dreamlike observation of people near a shoreline, with stillness and passing movement held in one frame.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片捕捉了宽阔明亮水面边一次难以辨认的聚集。中央前景，一位穿深色及小腿连衣裙的女子侧身从左向右经过。她的头肩轮廓柔软模糊，一只前臂略向前抬。运动让她的剪影比身后较静止的人群更有即时感。低处深色草地或泥土带占据画面下三分之一。其远缘，几个小人物分散坐成几组，朝向水面；另有几个浅色站立形体被运动或曝光柔化得近乎幽灵。背景人物的确切动作难以辨认。水面形成宽阔的发亮中间带，反射天空处近乎纯白。水的对岸，更深色的岸线与横向明暗带延伸到画面上缘。地平线很高，也不清晰。视点大致与站立人物平齐，让经过的女子在画面中显得高。强逆光把许多人压成简单剪影，让水面成为主要亮源。胶片颗粒、柔焦和不规则运动模糊遍布场景，尤其在左侧浅色人物与右边暗形上明显。照片保留前景深黑、水面的宽阔银白，而中间灰阶相对有限。没有可读标牌或文字。影像并不明确讲述某个事件，而像对岸边人群的短暂、近乎梦中的观察，把静止与经过的动作纳入同一画框。
style_prompt_en: Grainy monochrome photography reduces a crowded scene to dark silhouettes, a broad luminous horizontal field, and a few blurred upright forms. Strong backlight erases fine detail at the boundary between land and light, while the foreground remains almost black. Motion softness varies across figures, lending a fleeting, spectral quality without removing their spatial relationships. A high horizon and layered horizontal bands keep the composition calm beneath the unstable movement. Silver white highlights, charcoal masses, and sparse middle grays create an austere tonal scale. The surface stays visibly photographic and imperfect, with coarse texture and slight exposure haze. The mood is observational, quiet, and dreamlike.
style_prompt_zh: 颗粒感单色摄影把拥挤场景归纳为深色剪影、宽阔发亮的水平场域和少数模糊的竖向形体。强逆光抹去陆地与亮部交界处的细节，前景则近乎黑色。各人物的运动柔化程度不同，带来转瞬即逝的幽影感，同时保留空间关系。高地平线和层叠横带让构图在不稳定动作之下仍然平静。银白亮部、炭黑大块及稀少中灰形成简洁影调。表面明显保有摄影的不完美，带粗颗粒和轻微曝光雾。气氛像一次安静而如梦的观察。
theme_en: A blurred woman passing people gathered beside bright water
theme_zh: 一名模糊的女子走过亮水边聚集的人群
name: Harry Callahan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
